acceptance_evidence: Record board variant and whether wireless hardware is absent, physically disabled, or OS-disabled.
Record rfkill or equivalent evidence that Wi-Fi and Bluetooth are blocked before signing.
Record swap status proving no swap is active during signing sessions.
Record that SSH and remote login are disabled before signing sessions.
Record seed entry or session-secret input evidence showing no seed file, command-line secret argument, shell history entry, or persistent secret remains after signing.
Record that no persistent signing secret exists on boot media or attached storage after shutdown.
Record a power-cycle test showing an unfinished signing session is lost.
notes: This is an OS and operating-profile scaffold for future Raspberry/Pi stateless QR vault acceptance.
It is not a downloadable OS image, not a purchase instruction, and not a claim that real camera/display/GPIO drivers have been accepted.
TROPIC01 persistent-device work belongs to the TROPIC01 universal secure device, not this stateless QR vault profile.
